examples.en: I sent my sister a birthday message.
My friend got a job, so we all celebrated.

examples.ko: 결혼을 축하해 주러 많은 사람이 왔어요.
examples.en: Many people came to congratulate them on their wedding.
I bought a bouquet to congratulate them on graduating.

explain: '생일 축하해요', '합격 축하해요'처럼 축하할 일 뒤에 바로 써요. 웃어른께는 '축하드려요'라고 말해요. '축하해 주다'는 상대를 위해 해 주는 느낌이에요.

phrases.en: Grandma, happy birthday (congratulations on your birthday).
phrases.nuance_en: Used when speaking to someone older or higher in status.

phrases.en: My friends celebrated my birthday for me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 상대를 위해 해 주는 느낌이 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Has the feeling of doing it for someone.

phrases.en: Congratulations on graduating! You did great.
phrases.nuance_en: Casual speech for friends or those younger.

explain_en: It follows the occasion directly, as in '생일 축하해요' and '합격 축하해요'. To someone senior, say '축하드려요'. '축하해 주다' adds a feeling of doing it for the other person.
